node.title: XR agreement-raise quotient support safe sum is over budget
node.statement: The standard quotient-remainder support safe sum over active cells B-k<c is a valid threshold-uniform upper ledger, but at every clean XR candidate one active support-size term already exceeds B*. Thus generic support enumeration cannot pay quotient/profile migration in the agreement-raising induction. A sharper distinct-slope image/coalescing theorem, threshold-coherent first-match owner, or the static global pair-list route remains necessary; no actual quotient-union lower bound is claimed.
